As a result of litter, spray paint, and theft from a truck, the managers of the Montague complex have declared 'no more skateboarding.' 


Management's Deterrence: 1st running water / sprinklers. Then curbs were bolted to the banks.  Some curbs were removed by skaters. Then a steady security guard.

Harsh Vibes


As a result of litter, spray paint, and theft from a truck, the managers of the Montague complex have declared 'no more skateboarding.' 


Management's Deterrence: 1st running water / sprinklers. Then curbs were bolted to the banks.  Some curbs were removed by skaters. Then a steady security guard.
